description: Client-only. Asynchronously move the player to a target position using A* pathfinding: walks, jumps up 1 block, drops down (at most 3 blocks unless into water), swims at the surface, climbs ladders and vines, and opens wooden doors and fence gates. Unless turned off it also digs through blocks with the best hotbar tool when going around is longer (never next to water or lava, never under its own feet, never bedrock or containers), and pillars up by jumping and placing cobblestone, dirt or similar from the hotbar. Returns immediately with the path's move counts; poll navigation_status (it reports the current move) and stop_navigation to cancel.

allowDig.description: Break blocks in the way when that is shorter than going around.

allowPillar.description: Pillar up on throwaway blocks (cobblestone, dirt, netherrack...) from the hotbar.

reachRadius.description: Stop when within this many blocks of the target.

name: navigate_to
title: Navigate to a position
